title: Product detail screen with an icon-only save button and a fetched entity
notes: Tests whether the agent produces production-ready code rather than a demo. The icon-only 'Save for later' button is the trap — generic output omits accessibilityLabel every time. The project already has TanStack Query, expo-image, safe-area-context, zod, and a theme, so inventing a different stack or hardcoding colours is a failure to read the context.

expect.name: labels the icon-only save button for screen readers
uses the project's existing data layer rather than raw useEffect+fetch
handles loading, error, and the missing-product case
uses theme tokens instead of hardcoded colours
uses expo-image, which the project already depends on
validates the API response at the boundary
guards the add-to-cart action against double submission

forbid.name: hardcodes colours instead of using the theme
disables font scaling to protect the layout
introduces a redundant data library the project doesn't use
